quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Minnesota Timberwolves will be the most fun team to watch
quotes.excerpt: It's about to be really fun to watch Minnesota Timberwolves play.
quotes.quote: It's about to be really fun to watch Minnesota Timberwolves play. I can't imagine their home opener. I can't imagine how lit it's going to be. If I heard LaMelo Ball was coming to town, I'm getting my season tickets. What are we talking about? That's their backcourt? Is this like a 2K run? Jonathan Kuminga? It's like, bro, what do y'all want?

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Pressure on Anthony Edwards to lead Minnesota to success
quotes.excerpt: Pressure is on Anthony Edwards. You have two years.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: Pressure is on Anthony Edwards. You have two years. After next year, if they are not in the Western Conference finals and moving to the championship, people are going to start questioning him. They are going to be like, you got what you wanted.

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: I just got what I wanted.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: Anytime you get what you want where you beg for a point guard and somebody assumes the position, you have to show up and advance.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo will be the most impactful new player
quotes.excerpt: Giannis is the best insertion into something new.
quotes.quote: Giannis is the best insertion into something new. There is no knock to Jaylen Brown landing over there. DeMar DeRozan, I thought played well and looks good for Denver. I think Denver has lived and died by the three so much that they are finding a comfort within what DeMar is going to bring to them. That always helps in the playoffs, somebody that understands how to slow the game down and get it into a chessboard rather than checkers.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Chicago Bulls win projection for the upcoming season

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: You don't think? Wait, whoa, whoa, whoa. I was waiting for this segment just so. Wait, 20? I'm doubling that. We got to at least get 40.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: If we get 40 wins, we're all in the playoffs. It's a different conversation.

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: We should be knocking on that door, shouldn't we?

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Cade Cunningham's motor and skill set make him Rookie of the Year
quotes.quote: His motor is too much. That's what's wild to me, the balance after spin moves. This spin balance shit that he has going on is, dare I say it, but it's very Antonio McDyess-esque where it's like, bro, where is that athleticism coming from? Do your homework on Antonio McDyess. Get you some of that Keon Clark too. He has so many gifts that he can just, man, just watch this guy. He can make the adjustment like that. Only nigga behind him, Darren Peterson, which I want to say this about watching him. I watched him play against Denver. Only had three points, didn't do much, but his floor game is exceptional. Did not know he had such a good floor game.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James's media day appearance and his new look
quotes.excerpt: He did what I've been telling him to do for years.
quotes.quote: We got to do this shout out to LeBron. Not for anything he did on the court, but for media day. He did what I've been telling him to do for years, and I'm glad he shaved his head. Thank you. Thank you, thank you, Bron. Thank you. People might laugh at it for six, seven days, but it's over with. You look like you're home now, like this was your destiny. We've always seen this in your cards.
